annotations.title: Climeth an other way.
annotations.text: Whoſoeuer taketh vpon him to preach without lawful ſending, to miniſter Sacraments, and is not Canonically ordered of a true Catholike Biſhop, to be a Curate of ſoules, Perſon, Biſhop, or what other ſpiritual Paſtor ſo euer, and commeth not in by lawful election and holy Churches ordinance to that dignity, but breaketh in againſt order by force or fauour of men, and by humane lawes, he is a theefe and a murderer. ◦ So came in Arius, Caluin, Luther, and al Heretikes: and al that ſuccede them in roome and doctrine. And generally euery one that deſcendeth not by Lawful ſucceſſion in the knowen ordinarie line of Catholike Biſhops and Paſtors that haue been in al Countries ſince their conuerſion. And according to this rule S. Irenaeus li. 3 c. 3. trieth the true ſhepheards from the theeues and Heretikes. So doe Tertul. de Praeſcr. nu. 11. S. Cypr. de vnit. Ec. nu. 7. S. Auguſt. ep. 165. & cont. ep. Manich. c. 4. and Lirinenſis.

notes.text: Arch-heretikes specially, are the theeues that clime in an other way, not by the doore.

annotations.title: Good Paſtor.
annotations.text: The good Paſtor, is he whoſe ſpecial care is not of his owne aduantage, but of the ſafty of the flocke. The hireling, is he that reſpecteth not the profite and good of the flocke, but his owne lucre. The Woulfe is the Heretike, or any perſecutor of the Church, which is Chriſts flocke.

annotations.title: Fleeth.
annotations.text: Euery Biſhop and Paſtor is bound to abide with his flocke in times of danger and perſecution euen to death, ◦ except him ſelf be perſonally ſought for, rather then the flocke, or the flocke it ſelf forſake him. for in ſuch caſes the Paſtor may flee, as the Apoſtles did, and S. Athanaſius, and others. S. Athan. Apol. de ſua fuga. Auguſt. ep. 180.

notes.text: When the Pastor must tarie, or may flee.

annotations.title: The dedication.
annotations.text: [1] This is the feaſt of Dedication inſtituted by Iudas Machabaeus li. 1 Mach. c. 4. Chriſt vouchſafed to honour and keepe that feaſt inſtituted by him: & our Heretikes vouchſafe not to pray and ſacrifice for the dead, [2] vſed and approued by him. The Dedication alſo of Chriſtian Churches is warranted thereby, with the annual memories thereof. And it proueth that ſuch things may be inſtituted without any expreſſe commaundement in Scripture.

annotations.title: That vvhich he gaue me.
annotations.text: Thus read alſo diuers of the Fathers, namely S. Hilar. Trin. li. 7 poſt medium. S. Ambr. de Sp. S. li. 3. c. 18. S. Auguſt. in Io. tract. 48. S. Cyril. li. 7 in Io. c. 10. and vſe it to proue that Chriſt had his eſſence and nature of the Father. [1] And therfore ſome Heretikes of our time wickedly accuſe the Councel of Laterane for falſifying this place and applying it to the ſame purpoſe. Which they leſſe can abide, for that it is againſt Caluins Autotheiſme, [2] holding that Chriſt tooke his perſon of the Father, but not his ſubſtance. See the 2 Annot. in 1 Io. v. 1.

notes.text: Christs essence & diuine nature of the Father.
